items.source: Invoked after a DeferredResult has been set, via DeferredResult.setResult(Object) or DeferredResult.setErrorResult(Object), and is also ready to handle the concurrent result.
items.translation: 在通过 DeferredResult.setResult(Object) 或 DeferredResult.setErrorResult(Object) 设置 DeferredResult 后调用，并且也已准备好处理并发结果。

items.source: Start concurrent request processing and initialize the given DeferredResult with a DeferredResult.DeferredResultHandler that saves the result and dispatches the request to resume processing of that result.
items.translation: 启动并发请求处理，并使用保存结果并分派请求以恢复该结果处理的 DeferredResult.DeferredResultHandler 初始化给定的 DeferredResult。

items.source: Uses of DeferredResult in org.springframework.web.context.request.async
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.context.request.async` 包中 `DeferredResult` 的用法

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an error occurred while processing an async request before the DeferredResult has been set.
items.translation: 在设置 `DeferredResult` 之前，如果在处理异步请求时发生错误，则会在容器线程中调用。

items.source: Invoked from a container thread when an async request times out before the DeferredResult has been set.
items.translation: 在异步请求超时且尚未设置 `DeferredResult` 时，由容器线程调用。

items.source:
Invoked from a container thread when an async request completed for any
reason including timeout and network error.
items.translation: 由容器线程调用，当异步请求因任何原因（包括超时和网络错误）完成时。

items.source:
Invoked immediately before the start of concurrent handling, in the same
thread that started it.
items.translation: 在并发处理开始之前立即被调用，且在与启动该处理的同一线程中执行。

items.source:
Invoked immediately after the start of concurrent handling, in the same
thread that started it.
items.translation: 在并发处理的开始阶段立即被调用，且在与启动该处理相同的线程中执行。
